title: Fallen Angel in Graveyard
description: A monochrome angel with large feathered wings stands in a graveyard at night, wearing a fedora and long coat. He holds a blue rose while a glowing halo and white dove hover above his head, surrounded by broken stone columns, tombstones, and blooming flowers against a black sky with floating hats and birds.
prompt: A solitary winged angel dressed in a dark trench coat and fedora stands among ancient broken columns and tombstones in a moonlit graveyard. He holds a single vibrant blue rose. A glowing halo floats above his head as a white dove flies near him. Black night sky filled with floating hats and birds. Flowers and roses grow around the graves. Dramatic chiaroscuro, detailed linework, surreal and melancholic atmosphere.
